title: Run registration answer, through a gateway
description: The body of the server's signed 200, application/json, to a registration in the gateway shape of run-registration.schema.json: the run's id and its run key, which the starter passes to the run as QORY_RUN_KEY. It carries no run configuration, so the starter never receives the run's policy, and the answer has no X-Qory-Run-Configuration and no ETag: line 6 of its signature is empty, and line 5 carries X-Qory-Configuration as on every answer. The same bytes registered again under any active key of the same node or node pool get this answer again, with the same run key. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

run_key.description: The run key, at most 2048 characters: qrk_, the payload in base64url without padding, a dot, and the signature in base64url without padding. Its payload is run-key.schema.json, and its run_id is the run's.
